svg.title: Reefsong Current — Current-spanning dock bridges and three musical beacons
svg.desc: A fixed bridge parallels current-borne reef plates. Three wave beacons break the route into clear beats, with maintenance ladders and a rope-linked tuning loft.
svg.text: Current-spanning dock bridges and three musical beacons
